title: Looking for illustrator or digital artist

author: aisy
title: Calling all artists for project collaboration
content: Calling all artists 👋 I’m putting together a project and urgently need to find a few artists who may be interested in collaborating. Please send me: — Portfolio — Art style/specialty — Commission rates — Current availability I’m looking through submissions as they come in, so feel free to reach out even if you’re seeing this a little late. Thank you for helping spread the word!

author: La Biblioteca Dracónica
title: Se buscan ilustradores for book promo characters
content: 🚨Se buscan ilustradores 📢 Busco quien nos ilustre una serie de personajes, teniendo en cuenta que no todos serán humanos. Son imágenes para redes sociales, para promocionar nuestro libro. No para venderlas ni para ilustrar páginas. Sencillas, de personajes a solas o en grupo (se pedirán varias). Por favor, agradecería que añadierais vuestro portfolio y una lista de precios. También podéis escribirme en privado si lo preferís. Gracias.

author: The Manila Affair
title: Looking for artists for event posters (paid)
content: Calling all local artists! 🎨 We’re looking for artists to collaborate with on The Manila Affair’s event posters. We’d love to support local talent through output-based paid collaborations! Comment below if you’re interested, and we’ll reach out! 🤍
